statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits consistent with prior transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a known history of cerebral infarction
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The diagnosis codes are G45.9, I34.0, Z86.73
The service is ordered to evaluate for potential paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias that may be contributing to these embolic events
The service is medically necessary given the clinical presentation and prior embolic events
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific service is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
